name: Pont du Gard (Roman Aqueduct)
description: Rising nearly 50 metres above the Gardon river in southern France, the Pont du Gard is a three-tiered Roman bridge of stacked stone arches. It once carried water on a roughly 50-kilometre channel to the city of Nîmes. Its longest level stretches 275 metres, and you can still walk beside it and admire how well the sandy-gold stonework has survived two thousand years.
